$comment: Every version of @hirobius/design-system published to npm, oldest first (npm view @hirobius/design-system versions --json), and the one its open Version PR will publish. scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs --release adds each release here on its Version PR, with its snapshot and its ledger, and the release workflow publishes it when that PR merges (upgrade/README.md, At release time); a release cut without it is added by hand the day it publishes (Recording a release by hand). scripts/__tests__/upgrade-history.test.mjs fails while a release after the 0.16.0 floor lacks either.
